title: Gauged: Single CAMELS Forcing
subtitle: 531 basins, Newman evaluation decade (1989–1999) — Daymet, Maurer, or NLDAS without lagged streamflow.

rows.paradigm: Regional Single- & Multi-Forcing Long Short-Term Memory Network
rows.family_description: Author-archived 10-seed single-forcing (Daymet, Maurer, NLDAS) and multi-forcing (Daymet+Maurer+NLDAS, Daymet+Maurer, Daymet+NLDAS, Maurer+NLDAS) 256-unit CudaLSTM models with 365-day lookback window and 27 static CAMELS attributes, trained with NSE* loss over WY2000–2008 and evaluated over WY1990–1999 across all 531 CAMELS-US basins (Kratzert et al., 2021; Zenodo 10.5281/zenodo.4670268).
rows.notes: 10-seed ensemble mean of the Kratzert et al. (2021) 365-day lookback regional CudaLSTM trained with Daymet single-forcing meteorological inputs and 27 static catchment attributes across all 531 CAMELS-US basins (Zenodo 10.5281/zenodo.4670268; 531-basin Ensemble Med NSE = 0.772, Mean NSE = 0.728, Med KGE = 0.757; 447-basin subset Ensemble Med NSE = 0.783).

rows.paradigm: LSTM + 16-Bucket Differentiable HBV (Dynamic Parameters)
rows.family_description: 16-bucket differentiable HBV 1.1p (δMG) with capillary rise flux and time-varying (dynamic) soil-moisture recharge exponent β, near-surface recession coefficient K0, and ET shape parameter γ predicted daily by a 256-unit DropConnect LSTM with 15-day Gamma unit-hydrograph routing.
rows.notes: Clean-room PyTorch + C++/OpenMP re-implementation of Song et al. (2024) δHBV 1.1p (dynamic β, K0, γ + capillary rise C) trained on 531 CAMELS-US basins over WY1999-2008 and evaluated over WY1989-1999 with Daymet forcing; 5-seed ensemble mean (seeds 111, 222, 333, 444, 555; Med NSE = 0.759).

rows.paradigm: Regional Long Short-Term Memory Network (270-day lookback)

rows.notes: 8-seed ensemble mean of the Kratzert et al. (2019b) 270-day lookback regional LSTM with 27 static catchment attributes on Maurer single-forcing inputs across all 531 CAMELS-US basins (HydroShare 10.4211/hs.83ea5312635e44dc824eeb99eda12f06, Zenodo 10.5281/zenodo.3530884; 531-basin Ensemble Med NSE = 0.759, Mean NSE = 0.713, Med KGE = 0.742; 447-basin subset Ensemble Med NSE = 0.759).

rows.paradigm: Mass-Conserving Recurrent Neural Network (MC-LSTM)
rows.asterisk_reason: Evaluated in Hoedt et al. (2021) on the 447-basin Kratzert et al. (2019b) CAMELS subset.
rows.family_description: Mass-conserving LSTM where recurrent cell states act as non-negative water buckets updated via a column-stochastic redistribution matrix R[t], softmax input gate distributing unnormalized precipitation mass, sigmoid output gate, 64 hidden cells (1 trash cell for ET/percolation sink + 63 summed discharge readout cells), and z-scored auxiliary meteorological + 27 static catchment attributes.

rows.paradigm: Mass-Conserving Recurrent Neural Network (MC-LSTM)
rows.family_description: Clean-room PyTorch + Triton fused recurrent scan implementation of Hoedt et al. (2021) MC-LSTM (64 mass cells, column-stochastic redistribution matrix, 1 trash sink cell + 63 summed discharge cells, sequence length 365, NSE* loss). Includes single-forcing models and a 3-forcing multi-input configuration (arithmetic mean precipitation mass input with all 15 meteorological drivers + 27 static attributes in the auxiliary gate vector).

rows.paradigm: Dynamic-Parameter LSTM + 16-Bucket Differentiable HBV
rows.family_description: Differentiable process-based HBV 1.0 model coupling a regional 256-unit cuDNN LSTM parameter network with 16 parallel sub-basin conceptual HBV rainfall-runoff buckets (dynamic daily soil-moisture nonlinearity BETA and evapotranspiration exponent BETAET alongside 11 static bucket parameters) and a shared 15-day Gamma unit hydrograph routing kernel, trained end-to-end with combined linear/log-sqrt RMSE loss.
rows.notes: 5-seed ensemble (seeds 111, 222, 333, 444, 555) trained on 1999-10-01 to 2008-09-30 and evaluated on 1989-10-01 to 1999-09-30 across all 531 CAMELS-US basins with Daymet forcing.

rows.paradigm: Entity-Aware LSTM (Static-Attribute Input Gate)
rows.family_description: Entity-Aware Long Short-Term Memory network (EA-LSTM; H = 256 memory cells, T = 270-day sequence length, dropout = 0.4, basin-averaged NSE* loss) in which the 27 static CAMELS catchment attributes exclusively modulate a time-invariant sigmoid input gate i = sigma(W_i x_s + b_i) while the 5 dynamic extended Maurer meteorological forcings drive the forget, cell-candidate, and output gates across all 531 CAMELS-US basins (Kratzert et al., 2019b; Zenodo code archive 10.5281/zenodo.3530884; HydroShare hydrograph archive 10.4211/hs.83ea5312635e44dc824eeb99eda12f06).
rows.notes: Official 8-seed ensemble mean (seeds 111, 222, 333, 444, 555, 666, 777, 888) of the Entity-Aware LSTM (EA-LSTM) trained with basin-averaged NSE* loss on extended Maurer forcings and 27 CAMELS static catchment attributes over 1999-10-01 to 2008-09-30 and evaluated over 1989-10-01 to 1999-09-30 across all 531 CAMELS-US basins (Kratzert et al., 2019b, Table 2; Zenodo code archive 10.5281/zenodo.3530884; HydroShare hydrograph archive 10.4211/hs.83ea5312635e44dc824eeb99eda12f06; Ensemble Median NSE = 0.741, Mean NSE = 0.705, Median KGE = 0.737).

(2019b) EA-LSTM archive scored across all 8 individual seed members (seeds 111..888 in t3_23.zarr; evaluation_mode='single_member_mean') over 1989-10-01 to 1999-09-30 across all 531 CAMELS-US basins (Single-Model Median NSE = 0.712 ± 0.004, matching Kratzert et al., 2019b Table 2 reported 0.71 ± 0.005).

rows.paradigm: Conceptual Lumped Rainfall-Runoff Model (100-Member Calibrated Ensemble & 1000-Member Uncalibrated Random Ensemble)
rows.family_description: Conceptual semi-distributed/lumped HBV-light rainfall-runoff model (Seibert & Vis, 2012) providing dual upper and lower reference benchmarks on all 531 CAMELS-US basins forced by Maurer meteorology (Seibert et al., 2018; executed by Jan Seibert and Marc Vis for Kratzert et al., 2019b; HydroShare benchmark archive 10.4211/hs.474ecc37e7db45baa425cdb4fc1b61e1): HBV-upper (gauged__single_camels) is the 100-member genetically calibrated GAP ensemble upper benchmark over WY2000–2008, and HBV-lower (pub__single_camels) is the 1000-member uncalibrated random-parameter ensemble lower benchmark sampled uniformly from physically plausible parameter bounds (using zero target or donor streamflow observations, NOT a donor-transfer calibration).
rows.notes: Upper benchmark (HBV_ub): unweighted ensemble mean of 100 independent Genetic Algorithm + Powell (GAP) calibrations per basin (2,500 GA + 1,000 Powell evaluations per trial maximizing daily NSE over 1999-10-01 to 2008-09-30; evaluated over 1989-10-01 to 1999-09-30 across all 531 CAMELS-US basins; HydroShare archive 10.4211/hs.474ecc37e7db45baa425cdb4fc1b61e1, NetCDF variable HBV_ub; stores the pre-computed 100-member ensemble mean hydrograph as 1 array; Median NSE = 0.678 on 531 basins, 0.676 on the 447-basin Kratzert et al. 2019b Table 3 intersection).

rows.paradigm: Mesoscale Hydrologic Model (Basin Calibration)
rows.asterisk_reason: Evaluated on 492 of 531 CAMELS basins (39 basins missing in archive).
rows.family_description: Mesoscale Hydrologic Model (mHM; Samaniego et al., 2010) at 0.25° grid resolution forced by daily 1/8° Maurer meteorology and calibrated independently per basin via Dynamically Dimensioned Search (DDS) on MPR transfer-function parameters over WY2000–2008 and evaluated over WY1990–1999 (Mizukami et al., 2019; HydroShare benchmark archive 10.4211/hs.474ecc37e7db45baa425cdb4fc1b61e1).
rows.notes: Basin-calibrated mHM (0.25° hydrological grid with 1/48° MPR physiographic transfer functions calibrated independently per basin via DDS over 1999-10-01 to 2008-09-30; evaluated over 1989-10-01 to 1999-09-30; HydroShare archive 10.4211/hs.474ecc37e7db45baa425cdb4fc1b61e1, variable mHm_basin, Median NSE = 0.665 across 492 evaluated basins [0.666 on the 447-basin Kratzert et al. 2019b intersection]).

rows.paradigm: Conceptual Soil Moisture Accounting + Snow-17 Model (DDS & 29-D Donor Transfer)
rows.family_description: Clean-room C++17/OpenMP and Python re-implementation of coupled Snow-17 + SAC-SMA + 15-day Duamel Gamma unit hydrograph (27 calibrated parameters) calibrated per basin using Dynamically Dimensioned Search (DDS; Tolson & Shoemaker, 2007) over WY2000–2008 (Nearing et al., 2020), and extended to ungauged 12-fold PUB and 18-fold HUC-02 PUR prediction via k=1 nearest-neighbor donor parameter transfer in a 29-dimensional joint geographic and standardized static catchment-attribute space.
rows.notes: Clean-room 27-parameter Snow-17 + SAC-SMA + 15-day Duamel Gamma unit hydrograph calibrated independently per basin via DDS (400 iterations, r=0.2, 365-day spinup, daily RMSE objective) on Daymet forcings over 1999-10-01 to 2008-09-30 and evaluated over 1989-10-01 to 1999-09-30 across all 531 CAMELS-US basins (1 seed; Median NSE = 0.661).

rows.paradigm: Gradient-Boosted Decision Trees on Lagged Forcings (XGBoost)
rows.family_description: Regional Extreme Gradient Boosting (XGBoost; Chen & Guestrin, 2016) regression tree ensemble trained on 30 days of raw daily meteorological lag features (5 forcings x 30 lags = 150 dynamic features + 27 static catchment attributes = 177 input features) across all 531 CAMELS-US basins on Extended Maurer forcings over WY2000–2008 and evaluated over WY1990–1999 (Gauch, Mai, & Lin, 2021b, Environmental Modelling & Software 135, 104926; Zenodo 10.5281/zenodo.3648270).
rows.notes: Published and archived full-data benchmark from Gauch, Mai, & Lin (2021b, Environmental Modelling & Software 135, 104926, Table 2; Zenodo 10.5281/zenodo.3648270): regional XGBoost regressor with 30-day raw meteorological lag window (150 dynamic + 27 static = 177 features) trained on 1999-10-01 to 2008-09-30 and evaluated on 1989-10-01 to 1999-09-30 across all 531 CAMELS-US basins with Extended Maurer forcing (Ensemble Median NSE = 0.659 [0.6585 unrounded, 0.66 in Table 2], Mean NSE = 0.619, Median |FHV| = 27.79%, NSE <= 0 = 6 basins).

rows.paradigm: Framework for Understanding Structural Errors (Modular Conceptual Hydrology)
rows.asterisk_reason: Evaluated on 479 of 531 CAMELS basins available in the Kratzert et al. (2019b) HydroShare benchmark archive (52 basins missing).
rows.family_description: Framework for Understanding Structural Errors (FUSE; Clark et al., 2008) modular conceptual hydrology suite combining process components from PRMS, SAC-SMA, TOPMODEL, and ARNO/VIC with a degree-day snow module (naddor/fuse), calibrated independently per basin via SCE-UA on Maurer forcings over WY2000–2008 and evaluated over WY1990–1999 across three structural configurations (900, 902, 904; Addor et al., 2017; Kratzert et al., 2019b HydroShare benchmark archive 10.4211/hs.474ecc37e7db45baa425cdb4fc1b61e1).
rows.notes: FUSE structure 902 (PRMS tension1_1 upper layer + TOPMODEL unlimpow_2 nonlinear power-law baseflow + PRMS surface runoff +perc_f2sat + sequential ET + temp_index degree-day snow, no routing), calibrated per basin via SCE-UA minimizing RMSE on Maurer forcings over 1999-10-01 to 2008-09-30 and evaluated over 1989-10-01 to 1999-09-30 (HydroShare archive 10.4211/hs.474ecc37e7db45baa425cdb4fc1b61e1, variable q_sim_fuse_902; Median NSE = 0.654 across 479 valid basins in t3_43.zarr, 0.650 on the 447-basin Kratzert et al. 2019b intersection).

rows.paradigm: Regional LSTM without Catchment Attributes
rows.family_description: Regional single-layer Long Short-Term Memory network (H = 256 memory cells, T = 270-day sequence length, dropout = 0.4, basin-averaged NSE* loss) trained jointly across all 531 CAMELS-US basins using only the 5 dynamic extended Maurer meteorological forcings without any static catchment attributes (D_static = 0 input-ablation baseline from Kratzert et al., 2019b; Zenodo code archive 10.5281/zenodo.3530884; HydroShare hydrograph archive 10.4211/hs.83ea5312635e44dc824eeb99eda12f06).
rows.notes: Official 8-seed ensemble mean (seeds 111, 222, 333, 444, 555, 666, 777, 888) of the regional LSTM trained without static catchment attributes (D_static = 0, using only the 5 dynamic extended Maurer meteorological forcings and basin-averaged NSE* loss) over 1999-10-01 to 2008-09-30 and evaluated over 1989-10-01 to 1999-09-30 across all 531 CAMELS-US basins (Kratzert et al., 2019b, Table 2; Zenodo code archive 10.5281/zenodo.3530884; HydroShare hydrograph archive 10.4211/hs.83ea5312635e44dc824eeb99eda12f06; stored at t3_44.zarr; Ensemble Median NSE = 0.642, Mean NSE = 0.493, Median KGE = 0.631, 20 basins with NSE <= 0).

rows.paradigm: Framework for Understanding Structural Errors (Modular Conceptual Hydrology)
rows.asterisk_reason: Evaluated on 501 of 531 CAMELS basins available in the Kratzert et al. (2019b) HydroShare benchmark archive (30 basins missing).
rows.family_description: Framework for Understanding Structural Errors (FUSE; Clark et al., 2008) modular conceptual hydrology suite combining process components from PRMS, SAC-SMA, TOPMODEL, and ARNO/VIC with a degree-day snow module (naddor/fuse), calibrated independently per basin via SCE-UA on Maurer forcings over WY2000–2008 and evaluated over WY1990–1999 across three structural configurations (900, 902, 904; Addor et al., 2017; Kratzert et al., 2019b HydroShare benchmark archive 10.4211/hs.474ecc37e7db45baa425cdb4fc1b61e1).

rows.paradigm: Gradient-Boosted Decision Trees on Lagged Forcings (XGBoost)
rows.family_description: Regional Extreme Gradient Boosting (XGBoost; Chen & Guestrin, 2016) regression tree ensemble trained on 30 days of raw daily meteorological lag features (5 forcings x 30 lags = 150 dynamic features + 27 static catchment attributes = 177 input features) across all 531 CAMELS-US basins on Extended Maurer forcings over WY2000–2008 and evaluated over WY1990–1999 (Gauch, Mai, & Lin, 2021b, Environmental Modelling & Software 135, 104926; Zenodo 10.5281/zenodo.3648270).
rows.notes: Single-model evaluation of Gauch, Mai, & Lin (2021b, Environmental Modelling & Software 135, 104926; Zenodo 10.5281/zenodo.3648270) across all 531 CAMELS-US basins on 1989-10-01 to 1999-09-30 with Extended Maurer forcing (Single-Model Median NSE = 0.639; 0.6531 +/- 0.0023 across the 8 seeds seed111..seed888 in performance_gridEvaluation.ipynb).

rows.paradigm: Lumped Conceptual Soil Moisture Accounting + Snow-17 Model (Basin SCE-UA Calibration)
rows.asterisk_reason: Evaluated on 530 of 531 CAMELS basins (1 basin, USGS 01634500, is all-zero in the Newman et al., 2017 archive).
rows.family_description: Operational US National Weather Service Sacramento Soil Moisture Accounting (SAC-SMA) model coupled with the Snow-17 snow accumulation/ablation model and a Duamel Gamma unit hydrograph (Burnash et al., 1973; Anderson, 1973), calibrated independently per basin across 10 SCE-UA/DDS trials over WY2000–2008 and evaluated over WY1990–1999 (Newman et al., 2017; HydroShare benchmark archive 10.4211/hs.474ecc37e7db45baa425cdb4fc1b61e1).
rows.notes: Basin-calibrated Snow-17 + SAC-SMA + Duamel Gamma unit hydrograph from the NCAR/HydroShare CAMELS benchmark archive (Newman et al., 2017; HydroShare DOI 10.4211/hs.474ecc37e7db45baa425cdb4fc1b61e1). Note: The 10 SCE-UA/DDS calibrations per basin were archived as a single pre-averaged/selected hydrograph array (num_members=1 in t3_48.zarr without individual qsim_members; Median NSE = 0.607 across 530 non-zero basins in t3_48.zarr [basin 01634500 is all-zero], 0.603 on the 447-basin Kratzert et al. 2019b Table 3 intersection).

rows.paradigm: Regional LSTM without Catchment Attributes
rows.family_description: Regional single-layer Long Short-Term Memory network (H = 256 memory cells, T = 270-day sequence length, dropout = 0.4, basin-averaged NSE* loss) trained jointly across all 531 CAMELS-US basins using only the 5 dynamic extended Maurer meteorological forcings without any static catchment attributes (D_static = 0 input-ablation baseline from Kratzert et al., 2019b; Zenodo code archive 10.5281/zenodo.3530884; HydroShare hydrograph archive 10.4211/hs.83ea5312635e44dc824eeb99eda12f06).
rows.notes: Single-model evaluation of the official Kratzert et al. (2019b) LSTM without Static Attributes archive scored across all 8 individual seed members (seeds 111..888 in t3_44.zarr; evaluation_mode='single_member_mean') over 1989-10-01 to 1999-09-30 across all 531 CAMELS-US basins (Single-Model Median NSE = 0.593 ± 0.008, matching Kratzert et al., 2019b Table 2 reported 0.59 ± 0.008).

rows.paradigm: Distributed Land-Surface Hydrology Model (Basin SCE-UA Calibration)
rows.asterisk_reason: Evaluated on 530 of 531 CAMELS basins (1 basin, USGS 08082700, is missing in the Newman et al., 2017 archive).
rows.family_description: Variable Infiltration Capacity (VIC 4.1.2) macroscale land-surface hydrology model calibrated independently per basin using Shuffled Complex Evolution (SCE-UA) over WY2000–2008 and evaluated over WY1990–1999 (Newman et al., 2017; HydroShare benchmark archive 10.4211/hs.474ecc37e7db45baa425cdb4fc1b61e1).
rows.notes: Basin-calibrated VIC 4.1.2 (10 calibrated water-balance, snow, and routing parameters per basin via SCE-UA over 1999-10-01 to 2008-09-30; evaluated over 1989-10-01 to 1999-09-30; HydroShare archive 10.4211/hs.474ecc37e7db45baa425cdb4fc1b61e1, variable VIC_basin, Median NSE = 0.554 across 530 valid basins in t3_52.zarr [basin 08082700 missing]).

rows.paradigm: Mesoscale Hydrologic Model (CONUS Multiscale Parameter Regionalization)
rows.asterisk_reason: Evaluated on 492 of 531 CAMELS basins (39 basins missing in archive).
rows.family_description: Mesoscale Hydrologic Model (mHM; Samaniego et al., 2010) at 0.25° grid resolution forced by daily 1/8° Maurer meteorology and parameterized simultaneously across CONUS via Multiscale Parameter Regionalization (MPR; 48 global transfer-function parameters calibrated via DDS over WY2000–2008 and evaluated over WY1990–1999; Rakovec et al., 2019; HydroShare benchmark archive 10.4211/hs.474ecc37e7db45baa425cdb4fc1b61e1).
rows.notes: CONUS-wide Multiscale Parameter Regionalization (MPR) of mHM (single 48-parameter global transfer-function vector calibrated simultaneously across CONUS via DDS over 1999-10-01 to 2008-09-30; evaluated over 1989-10-01 to 1999-09-30; HydroShare archive 10.4211/hs.474ecc37e7db45baa425cdb4fc1b61e1, variable mHm_conus, Median NSE = 0.528 across 492 evaluated basins [0.527 on the 447-basin Kratzert et al. 2019b intersection]). Placed in Table 3 (gauged__single_camels) rather than Table 7 (PUB) because the CAMELS evaluation gauges were included in the CONUS-wide calibration objective during 1999–2008.

rows.paradigm: Differentiable Parameter Learning with Neural Surrogate VIC
rows.asterisk_reason: Evaluated on 498 of 531 CAMELS basins available in the Tsai et al. (2021) Figure 6a archive (Zenodo 10.5281/zenodo.6383415; g_Z variant achieves 0.435 median NSE on 499 basins).
rows.family_description: Differentiable Parameter Learning (dPL) using a static-attribute neural parameter network (g_A, trained via an iteratively refined 4-round LSTM runoff surrogate) to infer 8 basin-specific soil/infiltration parameters for the C-language Variable Infiltration Capacity (VIC 4.1.2) land-surface model and 2 Gamma unit-hydrograph routing parameters, evaluated with the physical C-language VIC 4.1.2 model over WY1990–1999.
rows.notes: Evaluated on 498 of 531 CAMELS basins from the authors' Figure 6a VIC validation archive (Zenodo 10.5281/zenodo.6383415, script_data/paper_results/figure6/gA_NSE_VIC.csv; calibrated on WY2000–2008 and evaluated with the physical C-language VIC 4.1.2 model on WY1990–1999; companion g_Z LSTM parameter network achieves 0.435 median NSE, -0.248 mean NSE, and 65 basins with NSE <= 0 across 499 basins). Note: Zenodo 10.5281/zenodo.6383415 archives only the per-basin NSE vectors without daily streamflow hydrographs or 8-digit USGS gauge IDs; row ID is t3_55 (t3_53.zarr in gauged__single_camels belongs to Gauch et al. 2021b XGBoost).

rows.paradigm: Distributed Land-Surface Hydrology Model (CONUS Multiscale Parameter Regionalization)
rows.family_description: Variable Infiltration Capacity (VIC 4.1.2) macroscale land-surface hydrology model parameterized across CONUS via Multiscale Parameter Regionalization (MPR-flex; 16 global transfer-function coefficients calibrated via SCE-UA over WY2000–2008 and evaluated over WY1990–1999; Mizukami et al., 2017; HydroShare benchmark archive 10.4211/hs.474ecc37e7db45baa425cdb4fc1b61e1).
rows.notes: CONUS-wide Multiscale Parameter Regionalization (MPR-flex) of VIC 4.1.2 (16 global transfer-function coefficients calibrated simultaneously across CONUS gauges via SCE-UA over 1999-10-01 to 2008-09-30; evaluated over 1989-10-01 to 1999-09-30; HydroShare archive 10.4211/hs.474ecc37e7db45baa425cdb4fc1b61e1, variable VIC_conus, Median NSE = 0.307 across all 531 CAMELS basins). Placed in Table 3 (gauged__single_camels) rather than Table 7 (PUB) because the CAMELS evaluation gauges were included in the CONUS-wide calibration objective during 1999–2008.

protocol.benchmark_name: CAMELS-531 Unified Model Intercomparison Project (Newman Period)
protocol.train_period: 1999-10-01 to 2008-09-30 (9 water years, water years 2000–2008; 3,288 daily steps)
protocol.eval_period: 1989-10-01 to 1999-09-30 (10 water years, water years 1990–1999; 3652 daily steps)

spatial_regimes.title: Gauged Simulation
spatial_regimes.description: Temporal split-sample across all 531 CAMELS-US benchmark basins: calibrated/trained on water years 2000–2008 (1999-10-01 to 2008-09-30) and evaluated out-of-sample on water years 1990–1999 (1989-10-01 to 1999-09-30).

spatial_regimes.title: Prediction in Ungauged Basins (12-Fold Random PUB)
spatial_regimes.description: Out-of-sample spatial cross-validation across k = 12 random folds of the 531 basins (44–45 basins/fold), trained on 11 folds during water years 2000–2008 and evaluated on the held-out fold during water years 1990–1999.

spatial_regimes.title: Prediction in Ungauged Regions (18-Fold HUC-02 PUR)
spatial_regimes.description: Zero-shot regional extrapolation across all 18 USGS two-digit HUC-02 hydrologic regions: trained on 17 regions during water years 2000–2008 and evaluated on the held-out HUC-02 region during water years 1990–1999.

forcing_regimes.title: Single CAMELS Forcing
forcing_regimes.description: Models driven by a single standard CAMELS-US meteorological dataset (Daymet, Maurer, or NLDAS) without lagged streamflow inputs.

forcing_regimes.title: Multiple CAMELS Forcings
forcing_regimes.description: Models driven simultaneously by any combination of two or three standard CAMELS-US meteorological datasets (Daymet, Maurer, and/or NLDAS) without lagged streamflow inputs.

forcing_regimes.title: With Lagged Streamflow Inputs
forcing_regimes.description: Models ingesting lagged observed streamflow, autoregression, or data assimilation alongside meteorological forcings (or donor-gauge transfer in PUB/PUR).

forcing_regimes.title: Freeform Forcings (Non-CAMELS Inputs)
forcing_regimes.description: Models driven by non-CAMELS meteorological forcing products (such as AORC, EM-Earth, or ERA5-Land).

provenance_categories.Literature: Skill scores extracted directly from a published paper evaluated on the standard splits.
provenance_categories.Archive: Metrics calculated by the MIP from publicly archived daily hydrographs associated with a prior published paper.
provenance_categories.Archive*: Metrics calculated by the MIP from publicly archived daily hydrographs on a partial basin subset (<531 basins) or non-standard time period.
provenance_categories.MIP Re-run: Published model re-implemented and re-run by the MIP on the standardized 531-basin splits.
provenance_categories.Contribution: New model contributed directly to the MIP benchmark.
